title: Murmur ContextPacket v2 (context = what OCR sees)
description: Binding definition: docs/ml/CONTEXT_V2.md. Screen text comes only from OCR of the screenshot; app and field from accessibility. prompts/render.py render_context_v2 turns this into the <context> block (budget/order/drop rules applied there, not by the OCR pipeline). Supersedes context.schema.v1.json.

category.description: messaging | work_chat | email | notes | code | search | address | social | default (prompts/tones/tones.v1.json; unknown -> default)

field.description: Absent when the app exposes no focused editable node.

kind.description: message | email_body | email_subject | search | address | note | code | generic (unknown -> 'text field')

before_cursor.description: Field text before the cursor (renderer keeps the last 300 chars).

box.description: Optional. [x0,y0,x1,y1] of the focused node in screenshot pixels (AccessibilityNodeInfo.getBoundsInScreen). Anchors the 'nearest to the field' order and removes OCR lines inside the field. Without it the anchor is the screen bottom.

password.description: Focused node is a password field. The app takes no screenshot then (screen absent) and should not call the LLM at all.

screen.description: OCR pipeline output (ml/ocr): filtered, repaired, de-duplicated, reading order. Absent when there is no screenshot (secure window, password field, denylisted app, error, nothing found).

level.description: full | app_only | none. full: app, field kind/hint, text before the cursor and screen text (if any). app_only: app, field kind and hint only (no screen text, no text before the cursor). none: as app_only and the app label is hidden. Unknown values (also the deprecated 'no_screenshot') render as full. Without a screen the phone MUST send the level that prompts/render.py NO_SCREEN_LEVEL gives for the reason (ADR-070): secure_window, denylisted_app -> app_only; password_field -> none (the LLM is never run, so such a ctx is never rendered and appears in no eval or training example); screenshot_error, ocr_empty -> full; user_setting -> app_only.

reason.description: null when a screen is present. Otherwise why it is absent: secure_window | denylisted_app | password_field | screenshot_error | ocr_empty | user_setting.
